text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Rice Shower reveals<n>to me that
she's afraid she'll<n>disappoint her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the past, all she would have done<n>was quiver in
fear, but now...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the joy on her fans'<n>faces and in
their cheers instills within<n>her enough confidence
for her to take<n>on the race.
